title: MUNICIPAL BREW
body: The machine is older than the building, or wants to be. Its label says MUNICIPAL BREW — SERVICE NOT REQUIRED. Your grounds fit the drawer. The system's coffee is always warm; yours is warm because you made it. This is a difference you are still allowed to keep.

choices.label: Make a cup. Drink it here.

outcome.text: It tastes like the city is not in the room for a minute. The machine hums, satisfied, like it has been waiting for a competent operator.

choices.label: Make a cup. Watch the pot warm.

outcome.text: The heating coil glows like a small, patient sun. Somewhere below, the building adjusts itself around the warmth. You are the only one who notices.

choices.label: Leave it. The system's coffee is fine.

outcome.text: It is always fine. That is the problem.
